comparisonRule: Compare quantity identity, method/reference and window before units; preserve unrecorded metadata as unknown. Compatibility is necessary but does not establish clinical validity.

mappings.permittedInterpretation: Accounting assumption; below 2,000 steps no downward adjustment.
mappings.nextTest: Specify baseline coverage and reference outcome before evaluating combined expenditure.

mappings.quantity: height-derived distance per step and incremental walking energy
mappings.reference: legacy strideMeters is single-step distance; net coefficient 0.5 kcal/kg/km
mappings.window: supplied daily steps above baseline allowance
mappings.permittedInterpretation: Keep proxy and net-energy assumptions visible.
mappings.unresolved: Actual step length, metabolic baseline and non-level gait cost unknown.
mappings.nextTest: Evaluate step-length terminology and provenance; test speed/grade/gait sensitivity separately from step accuracy.

mappings.reference: gross MET × kg × hours minus 1.2×RMR/24 × hours, floored at zero
mappings.permittedInterpretation: Gross and net require a named reference and matching interval.
mappings.unresolved: Session presets and fixed conversion not individualized.
mappings.nextTest: Test baseline compatibility and floor behavior before combining or reconciling increments.

mappings.quantity: FFM, fat mass, SMM and residual
mappings.window: same assessment occasion for arithmetic interpretation
mappings.permittedInterpretation: SMM is not FFM; residual is model arithmetic; absent SMM is unknown.
mappings.nextTest: Define method-aware composition provenance and reject silent construct substitution.

mappings.reference: normal-interval variability statistic, not generic recovery
mappings.permittedInterpretation: Retain distinct metrics; compare only after method review.
mappings.unresolved: Sampling, window and preprocessing may be missing.
mappings.nextTest: Define compatible comparison keys; retain unknown fields rather than coercing provider values.

mappings.reference: default is software input, not a measurement
mappings.permittedInterpretation: Validation bounds do not establish clinical eligibility.
mappings.unresolved: Current API does not retain origin.
mappings.nextTest: Design explicit origin and missingness states while preserving existing API compatibility.

mappings.unresolved: Joint mass/BF errors and their distribution unknown.
mappings.nextTest: Carry joint-input error question to H3 and interval coverage to H6.

mappings.window: explicit start/end and offset; active end may be absent
mappings.permittedInterpretation: Null is missing; incomplete is not a full calendar day.
mappings.unresolved: Workout steps contributing to cycle total unknown.
mappings.nextTest: Require documented contribution evidence and explicit conversion semantics before reconciliation.

mappings.permittedInterpretation: Vendor recovery is not a direct Metron readiness observation.
mappings.unresolved: No common recovery-scale or metric-window equivalence.
mappings.nextTest: Keep raw metric and vendor assessment separate in an eventual adapter.

mappings.permittedInterpretation: File access does not establish semantic equivalence.
mappings.unresolved: Full definitions and inclusion rule remain unverified.
mappings.nextTest: Inspect lawful field documentation before any optional local payload experiment.

mappings.quantity: workout-associated samples, raw day query, statistics
mappings.window: pilot start-day raw strictStartDate; statistics predicate options []
mappings.permittedInterpretation: UUID intersection proves identical returned objects only.
mappings.unresolved: Merged sample weights, denied/full read state and complete history unobservable from this comparison.
mappings.nextTest: Add synthetic midnight/DST/cap/missing-history cases before considering an optional on-device study.
